money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $15,000.00

output.sourceIssueCandidate: The agreement is titled 2020-2021 and is being ratified, but its stated service period is July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022.
output.summary: The board is ratifying (formally approving) an agreement with Cityspan Technologies, Inc. of Berkeley, CA, to build a summer database that tracks student-level attendance for the Expanded Learning Office. Cityspan will also import after-school attendance from the district's AERIES student records system and help send monthly data to the Oakland Fund for Children and Youth (OFCY) database. The agreement runs July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022 and costs up to $15,000, paid from After School Education and Safety (ASES) and 21st Century Community Learning Centers grant funds.
